verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say variance analysis runs on the same platform as budgeting and can flag the reasons behind gaps, so the core budget-vs-actuals capability is first-party. Nothing in the pack shows how far it goes: department or account breakdowns and drill-down to underlying transactions are not documented. missing for 10: documented department-and-account variance views, drill-down into the transactions behind a variance, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, budget-vs-actuals runs by department and account, with drill-down into the transactions behind a variance

citations.quote: Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget. Understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps
